NuvioDesktop.name: Nuvio Live TV — build 24
NuvioDesktop.body:
**Windows desktop:** download `Nuvio-LiveTV-Windows.msi` and double-click it.
It replaces the regular Nuvio desktop app and keeps your settings. If Nuvio later offers an app update, skip it: that update doesn't include Live TV.

Sign in with your Nuvio account, then open the **Live TV** tab and paste your addon's manifest link.

Android phones and iPhones/iPad: see the releases of dslayer6989/NuvioMobile. Android TV: see the releases of dslayer6989/NuvioTV.

NuvioMobile.name: Nuvio Live TV Mobile — build 7
NuvioMobile.body:
**Android phone and tablet:** download `Nuvio-LiveTV-Android-phone.apk`, open it, and allow installing from this source when asked.
It installs next to the official Nuvio app as **Nuvio Live TV**. The `older-32bit`, `x86` and `x86_64` files are for unusual devices; most phones want the `phone` file.

**iPhone and iPad:** install **Nuvio Live TV** through TestFlight (use the link you were given).
The file `Nuvio-LiveTV-iOS.ipa` is an unsigned copy for SideStore or AltStore; it won't install by itself.

Sign in with your Nuvio account, then open the **Live TV** tab and paste your addon's manifest link.

NuvioTV.name: Nuvio Live TV (Android TV) — build 6
NuvioTV.body:
Nuvio Live TV for Android TV, build 6.
Built from commit b9aaadf66314b4a4cf779ad101e0b2f0f14d12bb. Installs next to official Nuvio (app id com.nuvio.app.livetv.atv).

NuvioTVSmart.name: Nuvio Live TV for Samsung & LG (livetv-smarttv-v1.0.0)
NuvioTVSmart.body:
Nuvio Live TV for Samsung (Tizen 5.0 and newer, 2019+) and LG (webOS 5 and newer) TVs.

Built from NuvioMedia/NuvioTVSmart at `c8674f2d` plus the Live TV patch (`nuvio-livetv-smarttv.patch`).
It installs next to NuvioMedia's own Nuvio TV app as "Nuvio Live TV".

**Install:** use the Nuvio TV Smart Installer from dslayer6989/NuvioTVSmart-Installer
(Samsung: Developer Mode with your computer's IP; LG: the Developer Mode app).

**First run:** open Live TV in the sidebar and choose "Set up with your phone" (scan the QR code)
or "Type the link", then enter your addon link, for example https://dslayer6989.github.io/Stremio-TV

**Remote:** arrows, OK and Back do everything. Hold OK for channel options. In the player,
Left (or the green button) opens the channel list and CH▲/▼ change channel.
Red = favorite, Yellow/Blue = 2 hours back/ahead in the guide.

NuvioTVSmart-Installer.name: Nuvio TV Installer 0.1.1 (Nuvio Live TV)
NuvioTVSmart-Installer.body:
Installer for **Nuvio Live TV** on Samsung (Tizen 5.0+) and LG (webOS 5+) TVs.

- Installs the newest release from dslayer6989/NuvioTVSmart (first one: `livetv-smarttv-v1.0.0`).
- Launch, Update and Remove now target the Live TV app (Samsung `NuvioLive1.NuvioLiveTV`, LG `com.wgdively.nuvio.livetv`), which sits next to NuvioMedia's own Nuvio TV app.

Windows, macOS and Linux files are added to this release by its build a few minutes after it's published.
